latest_release.name: OpenMausBot 0.1.155
latest_release.body:
## What's new in 0.1.155

### Usage bars are back
- **The usage bars next to the model name show your Claude plan again,** in Simple and Advanced, with the 5-hour and weekly figures at the top of the model menu. Codex, Grok and OpenCode Go keep theirs.

### Cloud computers
- **A cloud computer that stops answering is no longer shown as ready.** MausBot restarts it once when that is safe, tells you and the bot plainly, and the computer panel has **Restart computer** and **Replace computer**.
- **A cloud computer that fails to start can be reset** from the same panel.
- **A lent computer's menu names the bot using it.**

### Rooms and chats
- **Drag rooms into the order you want** in the sidebar.
- **Room messages show who is speaking to whom,** with the sender's name in the bot's colour.
- **Long bot-to-bot requests fold to one line,** with a side view of the whole exchange.
- **A bot can post one message into an existing thread.**
- **Attach archives** (.zip, .tar.gz, .7z and others) as plain files.
- **A typed reply closes a bot's earlier questions,** so the "Waiting" badge clears.
- **Restart turn and Stop and send say they also stop work handed to other bots.**

### Settings
- **Import & export** has its own page, in Simple and Advanced.
- **Pairing and settings hints point at the pages that exist now** (AI › Other services, Routing and extraction).

### Team Cloud
- **No flash of a team bot's shared chat on start-up,** and the phone's bot list stays open at start.
- **The Chief says which department a refusal is about** and which setting unlocks it.

### Automations
- **Webhook triggers can filter on a field in the payload.**
- **Webhook and app-event automations can keep one conversation** instead of starting a new one each time.

### Engines and computers
- **OMP engine.**
- **Take over a bot's USB-connected Android phone** from the Android tab (experimental).
- **Fish Audio for live calls.**
- **VPS: an optional wake script** resumes a host that pauses when idle.
- **1Password access can be granted item by item.**
- **An OpenCode Go limit no longer blocks the free OpenCode models** on the same sign-in.

### Fixes
- **A chat you followed from a notification is marked read once,** not twice.
- **Windows-1252 Markdown files open in the preview.**
- **A replayed image is marked as already sent,** so the model doesn't treat it as new.
- **Copilot keeps MCP servers out of the reserved browser and computer names.**
- **A system stop is no longer counted as your stop.**
- **A read-only HighLevel grant lets HighLevel's reads through.**
- **A paired client shows and opens the host's Local VM** for a bot that runs there.



**npm:** `npx openmausbot@0.1.155` · https://www.npmjs.com/package/openmausbot/v/0.1.155
